name: Marcus Idris
bio: Twelve years coaching competitive powerlifters and total beginners alike. Marcus believes the bar doesn't care about your excuses, but your joints do — every program he writes respects recovery as much as load.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya pairs every training block with a nutrition plan because she's seen too many good programs fail on the kitchen side. She specializes in turning first-time gym members into confident lifters within 60 days.

name: Diego Alvarez
bio: Former semi-pro footballer who now builds the conditioning sessions everyone complains about and then thanks him for. Diego scales every circuit so beginners and athletes train in the same room without either being short-changed.

name: Sofia Lindqvist
bio: Sofia spent six years in physiotherapy before moving into coaching, and it shows — her recovery sessions are the reason members of this gym train into their 40s and 50s without the usual wear and tear.
